title: Code and data for: Machine Learning Prediction of Ge-X (X=C, H, N, O) Bond Dissociation Energies via DFT Trained Data: A Comparative Study
description: Python code, dataset (1,183 organogermanium compounds with CAM-B3LYP/LANL2DZ electronic dissociation energies), descriptors, train/test split, model results, Ge benchmark against experiment, and Gaussian job summaries accompanying the article.
